text.aria-label: Title text 'Short transfers are found less often than long ones'

g.text: Short transfers are found less often than long ones

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is one big injected transfer of 25% or 40% of the receiving load, fitted on its own window. The setting without a drift term is the one the same tuning rule chose, which has to be very stiff to keep unconnected pairs clean and so finds almost nothing.'
text.tspan: Each dot is one big injected transfer of 25% or 40% of the receiving load, fitted on its own
window. The setting without a drift term is the one the same tuning rule chose, which has to be
very stiff to keep unconnected pairs clean and so finds almost nothing.
